# Copilot instructions

This repository contains Markdown study notes for the GitHub Copilot architecture exam.

- Create and edit Markdown files only. The sole non-Markdown exception is `.github/workflows/markdown-only.yml`.
- Verify product and architecture claims against current official GitHub documentation, and include source links near the relevant notes.
- In pull request reviews, prioritize factual accuracy, outdated claims, source quality, clarity, and Markdown formatting.
- If a claim cannot be verified, identify the uncertainty instead of presenting it as fact.
